764.note: Loop Třinec – Vendryně – Karpentná – Třinec every 2 h at :35 in the morning (8:35, 10:35, 12:35), then 13:35, 14:20, 16:35, 18:35. One bus every 180 with two slots, 13:35 and 14:20 (also 16:35, 10:35 on the minute). 12:35 and 18:35 are 60 min off the pattern; 14:40 to Záolší only is not a loop trip.

766.note: The same loop the other way round: 9:35, 11:35, 13:35 and 15:40 (the 13:24 is a Záolší – Třinec trip passing the bus station). One bus every 120 at 15:40 (odd hours :40, so 9:35–13:35 are 5 min early against it).

769.note: Třinec – Lyžbice – Vendryně hourly: Třinec :35, Vendryně :00 most of the day.

770.note: Bystřice, station – Paseky about hourly at irregular minutes: station 13:10, 13:45, 14:51, 15:55, 17:45, 18:50; Paseky 13:30, 15:05, 16:50, 18:00 (the 14:00 from Paseky runs to Třinec without the station). No hourly slot passes Step 4 (13:30 and 15:05 are 95 min apart), and one slot every 120 would halve the line, so every 180 with two slots each way, exact in the model hours: station 13:45 and 14:51 (also 16:45, 17:51), Paseky 13:30 and 15:05 (also 16:30, 18:05); two buses (one more; the one-bus option is on the owner checks). Off the pattern: 13:10, 15:55, 18:50 out, 16:50, 19:00 back; their stops are all on this line. The diversion timetable (to 12 Dec) is the one that runs.

771.note: Bystřice – Nýdek, náměstí every 1–2 h at irregular minutes (station 13:05, 13:50, 16:45, 17:45; Nýdek 14:00, 15:10, 18:00, 19:00). One bus every 120: station 13:50 (odd hours :50), Nýdek 14:00 (even hours :00, on the minute at 8:00, 12:00, 14:00 and 18:00); the real bus turns at Nýdek in 2 min. The Setinka trips (Bystřice 15:10 via náměstí) are left out of these rows: the few Hluchová trips are 771 Hluchová, every 480 on the afternoon pair (Bystřice 12:25, Setinka 12:47; 4:37 back in the morning); 14:50 from Třinec to Setinka is listed off the pattern. Hluchová has no other line.

772.note: Třinec – Bystřice – Nýdek, Gora every 3 h (Třinec 15:40, Gora 16:45).

773.note: Bystřice – Nýdek, Střelmá: a few short workings a day. Every 480 on the afternoon pair (Nýdek, náměstí 12:33 → Střelmá, 12:42 back to Bystřice), timed at Bystřice so the bus passes náměstí at 12:33; 4:20 from Bystřice fits too. Střelmá has no other line.

781.note: Návsí – Jablunkov – Mosty, Šance about hourly (Návsí :58 / :03, Šance :25 / :30), but in the afternoon the 15:03 is replaced by the Třinec through trip (Návsí 14:43) and the 16:30 back by a Hrčava trip, so no hourly slot passes Step 4. Every 120 with two slots each way, exact in the model hours: Návsí 14:03 and 14:43 (even hours), Šance 14:35 (even) and 15:30 (odd); two buses, as before (the live map’s 7E18816 runs 14:03 → 14:35, 74-1105 runs 14:43 → 15:30 → 16:03). 12:58 and 17:03 out, 12:25, 13:25, 18:30 back are off the pattern (5–20 min). The Hrčava trips (also those via Šance: Návsí 10:58, 18:58) are 781 Hrčava from Jablunkov every 3 h (15:00 out, 14:06 / 17:06 back).

782.note: Návsí – Radvanov – Jablunkov: one afternoon round (Návsí 14:55 → Radvanov, 15:05 → Jablunkov), every 480; the bus returns to Návsí empty (5 min). Radvanov has no other line.

783.note: Třinec – Jablunkov – Písečná – Bukovec, the valley trunk. Out of Třinec hourly at :05 most of the day, with a bunch 13:00–15:13 (13:28, 14:15, 14:35, 15:13); back from Bukovec to Třinec 13:32, 14:17, 15:15 (timed at Jablunkov :52 / :37 / :37). The main rows count the trips that run through to Bukovec. Every 180 with three slots each way, exact in the model hours: Třinec 13:28, 14:15, 15:13; Bukovec 13:32, 14:17, 15:17 (Jablunkov 13:52, 14:37, 15:37); three buses (was four). Off the pattern: 14:35 out (74-1112 stays in the valley, Bukovec 15:37 to Návsí), 13:00, 16:10, 18:18; back 13:07, 16:37; and the Návsí / Jablunkov – Bukovec and Třinec – Jablunkov short trips (their stops are on this line). Návsí – Písečná točna every 90 is 783 Písečná (with the Třinec – Písečná trips 14:18, 18:05); the Ski areál trips (Třinec 14:00) every 480 are 783 Ski areál, which also serves Hraniční přechod and Písek, škola, so the few trips via the border crossing (Bukovec 13:00, Třinec 6:28) have no line of their own.

784.note: Návsí – Dolní Lomná – Horní Lomná, Horní Přelač about hourly (Návsí :55, 16:00, 17:00; Přelač :25, 14:30, 15:30, 18:30), timed so the bus passes Horní Lomná, střed on time. No hourly slot is exact (the afternoon drifts to :00 / :30), so every 180 with two slots each way, exact: Návsí 14:55 and 16:00, Přelač 14:30 and 16:25 (the 16:00 and 16:25 are the trips that turn at Horní Lomná, střed). Two buses, as seen. Off the pattern: 12:55, 13:55, 17:00, 18:05 out; 12:25, 15:30, 17:25, 18:30 back.

786.note: Jablunkov – Milíkov – Bystřice, Na Paseky: one round every 4 h (Jablunkov 13:33, Paseky 14:57). The diversion timetable (to 12 Dec) runs. Bocanovice has no other line.

787.note: Jablunkov – Návsí – Milíkov – Bystřice, Na Paseky. Jablunkov sends few trips (12:25, 14:15, 14:50, then 20:23), Paseky more (12:56, 13:56, 14:44, 16:01, 17:56, 19:01; the buses run Košařiska and Milíkov shorts in between). One bus every 120: Jablunkov 14:50 (even hours :50), Paseky :58 in odd hours (13:58, 15:58, 17:58: within 3 min of 13:56, 16:01, 17:56); 74-1001 runs 14:50 out and 16:01 back on the live map. 14:15 and 14:44 are off the pattern. The Třinec – Bystřice trips are 787 Třinec, one bus every 90 (Třinec 14:59, Paseky 15:24). The diversion timetable (to 12 Dec) runs.

788.note: Jablunkov – Lísky: four rounds a day, every 240 (Jablunkov 15:10, Lísky 15:20).

731.note: Český Těšín – Albrechtice every 3 h (15:38 / 16:05). The shift trips on to Stonava and Karviná, Důl Darkov (Svibice 12:35, Darkov 6:09 and 14:09) have no line of their own: their stops are on 731 and on the Havířovsko/Karvinsko/Orlovsko lines (563, 582 ČSM). Regular route, not the Stonava mines diversion (network state).

739.note: Český Těšín – Třanovice – Dobrá – Frýdek every 4 h (14:15 / 15:00). Třanovice, Na Cymbálce has no other line.

732.note: Jablunkov/Třinec – Český Těšín – Těrlicko – Havířov, Město, station, about hourly at irregular minutes, read at Český Těšín, autobusová stanice (the knot every trip passes). In the model hours (13:00–15:00) two trips run towards Havířov (Třinec 13:25 and 14:55, Těšín 13:45 and 15:15) and five leave Havířov (13:17, 13:52, 14:07, 14:27, 14:35): the extra buses go on to other lines at Český Těšín and Třinec (14:07 ends at Těšín and goes on as 734, 13:17 goes on as 733, 14:35 runs on to Jablunkov). So the line runs at the rate towards Havířov: every 180 with two slots each way, Třinec 13:25 / 14:55 (Těšín 13:45 / 15:15, exact) and Havířov 13:52 / 14:27 (the turns of 73-0009 and 73-0016); the other Havířov departures are off the pattern. The trips to Havířov, Podlesí, Těšínská (Třinec 14:10, 14:15, 15:50) and the Těšín – Havířov short trips are not on this line; their stops are on other lines. Two buses.

733.note: Český Těšín – Těrlicko, Hradiště, U Stonávky: out-and-back rounds every 1½–2 h (Těšín 13:15, 14:50, 16:45, 18:35; U Stonávky 13:41, 15:29, 17:10). In the model hours one trip out (14:50) and two back (13:41, 15:29): every 120, Těšín 14:50 and U Stonávky 15:29, both exact, one bus. Off the pattern: 13:15, 16:45 (5 min) and 18:35 out, 13:41 and 17:10 back, and the short trips to Kaménka and to Třinec.

734.note: Short trips between the Třinec and Český Těšín bus stations about every 1–1½ h at irregular times (Třinec 12:40, 14:20, 15:30, 17:30, 19:10; Těšín 13:05, 14:05, 15:05, 16:05). Every 180 with two slots each way: Třinec 14:20 and 15:30, Těšín 15:05 and 16:05 (13:05 exact too), all exact, one bus (73-0021 turns at Třinec 15:26 → 15:30). Off the pattern 12:40, 17:30 (10 min) and 19:10 out, 14:05 back.

735.note: Český Těšín – Těrlicko, střed (some trips from Třinec or on to Havířov and Třanovice) at irregular times: Těšín 13:00, 14:50, 15:50, 16:50, 18:55; Těrlicko 13:35, 15:09, 16:52, 17:38, 19:25. Every 96, Těšín 16:50 and Těrlicko 16:52 (both exact; 13:38 / 15:14 and 13:40 / 15:16 come within 5–7 min of 13:35 and 15:09), two buses as published. Off the pattern 15:50 (its bus comes back at 16:52), 13:00, 14:50, 18:55 out and 17:38, 19:25 back.

736.note: Český Těšín – Chotěbuz at irregular minutes (Těšín 13:35, 14:25, 14:55, 16:20, 17:20, 18:55; Chotěbuz 13:55, 14:45, 15:20, 16:40, 17:40, 19:20). One bus every 160 with two slots each way, on the two rounds of 73-0003: Těšín 13:35 and 14:25, Chotěbuz 13:55 and 14:45, all exact; 18:55 out is exact too. 14:55 / 15:20 (73-0031) and the later rounds (5–15 min) are off the pattern.

738.note: Svibice, Slovenská – Karviná every 30 most of the day (Slovenská :17 / :47, Karviná :12 / :42), but in the afternoon peak extra trips make it three an hour at shifted minutes: Slovenská 13:52, 14:17, 14:37, 14:57, 15:22, 15:47; Karviná 13:57, 14:34, 14:52, 15:12, 15:39. Every 30 leaves half its peak slots without a trip, and no later model hour fits every 30 either (the minutes settle only after 17:00). So every 90 with four slots each way, at the peak rate: Slovenská 13:52, 14:17, 14:37, 14:57 (repeating 15:22, 15:47), all six exact; Karviná 14:34, 14:52, 15:12, 15:39 exact, 13:57 off by 12. The real buses turn at Slovenská in 1 min. Four buses (every 30 needs three: owner check).

745.note: Komorní Lhotka – Hnojník, obch.stř.: one bus shuttles at irregular minutes, some trips go on to Třanovice (745 Třanovice). The main rows count only the trips that turn at Hnojník; the Třanovice trips are 745 Třanovice’s, not folded in. Model hours (14:10–16:10): Lhotka 14:16 out, Hnojník 14:35, 15:05, 15:37 back; the extra Hnojník departures are buses of other rows (15:05: 73-0022, which came on 750’s short from Třinec; 15:37: 73-0028 back from Třanovice by the 15:11 Třanovice – Hnojník short). Every 120, Lhotka 14:16 and Hnojník 15:37, one bus; 14:35 and 15:05 and the evening trips (Lhotka 17:31–20:11, Hnojník 18:12–20:47) are off the pattern. 745 Třanovice: every 120, Lhotka 15:31 to Třanovice and back 16:06 (the round of 73-0022), one bus; 13:21, 14:51, 16:31 out and 17:06 back are off the pattern.

747.note: Český Těšín – Vělopolí – Střítež hourly in the afternoon: Těšín :45 (14:45, 15:45, 16:45), Střítež :15 (16:15, 17:15). One bus every 60, exact; 15:20 from Hnojník (5 min), the morning and midday trips and the Hnojník school trips are off the pattern.

748.note: Střítež – Řeka: one bus shuttles all afternoon (73-0027 from 15:14). Střítež hourly at :11 (16:11, 17:11), Řeka 15:40, 16:30, 17:35. Every 120: Střítež 16:11 and 17:11 (the hourly :11 as two slots), Řeka 15:40 and 16:30, all exact; 17:35 (5 min), 19:01 and the Třinec – Řeka trips are off the pattern. One bus.

750.note: Třinec – Hnojník – Dobrá – Frýdek-Místek. In the afternoon the trips run as a shift wave: out of Třinec 12:35, 12:50, 13:25, 13:50, 14:20 and then not until 16:45; out of Frýdek 13:18, 14:20, 14:35, 14:50, 15:35, 15:40, 16:40. In the model hours (13:50–15:50) two leave Třinec and five leave Frýdek; the extra Frýdek departures are buses that came in on 739 and 751 and change line number there (73-0007, 73-0001, 73-0005, 73-0038). So the line runs at Třinec’s rate: every 180 with two slots each way, on the real rounds of 73-0026 (Třinec 13:50 → Frýdek 14:50) and 73-0006 (14:20 → 15:40), all exact, two buses. The other afternoon trips are off the pattern (751 and 752 run the same road).

754.note: Třinec – Ropice – Český Těšín about hourly at irregular minutes, with extras at 13:45 and 14:22; every afternoon trip is a different bus going on to another line (the 73- buses rotate between 732–754 at both bus stations). Every 144 with three slots each way: Třinec 13:45, 14:22, 15:30 and Těšín 13:40, 14:20, 15:10, all exact (13:06 / 16:09 and 16:04 / 17:34 come within 4–6 min of 13:10, 16:15 and 16:10); 14:15 is off by 7. Two buses.

721.note: Circle via Hrabinská, the central cemetery, Mosty and Svibice about every 40 at irregular minutes (diversion timetable via Nová Tovární to 12 Dec): 13:25, 14:15, 14:51, 15:31, 15:50, 17:14. Every 120 with three slots: 14:15, 14:51, 15:31, all exact, one bus; 12:46 and 13:25 (5–6 min), 15:50 and the evening trips are off the pattern, and the Lípová short trips have no line of their own. 721 Mosty: station – Mosty, osada Antoníček – Nová Tovární (station 12:55, 13:55, 15:00, 16:26; Antoníček 13:19, 14:19, 15:24, 16:44): every 144 with two slots, station 13:55 and 15:00, Antoníček 14:19 and 15:24 (the rounds of 1TI2913), all exact, back to the station empty, one bus; 12:55 and 16:26 (7 min) are off the pattern.

722.note: The same circle the other way round: 13:22, 14:01, 14:25, 14:55, 15:15, 16:05, 16:35, 18:15. The model hours hold five trips, two of them 20 min apart (14:55, 15:15), so one bus cannot run them. Every 180 with five slots: 13:22, 14:01, 14:25, 14:55, 15:15, all exact, two buses; 16:05 and 16:35 (13–17 min) are off the pattern. Every 40 with one bus, as before, leaves two of its three model-hour slots without a trip (owner check).

723.note: Station – bus station – Dolní and Horní Žukov hourly: station :35 most of the day (15:35, 16:39 in the model hours), Horní Žukov :00 (16:00, 17:02). Every 60, station :37 (within 2 min of 15:35 and 16:39) and Horní Žukov :00, one bus; the station slot is timed so the bus passes the bus station at :44.

724.note: Station – Na Mojském – central cemetery: two rounds a day (10:22, 18:25), every 480. The cemetery stops have no other line.

701.note: Circle from Sosna hospital via the station and Lyžbice every 30 (:00 / :30), two buses.

702.note: Kanada, školy – bus station – station: frequent only 12:40–15:22 (and in the morning), at irregular minutes, every trip on a bus that comes from or goes on to another Třinec line. Every 90 with four slots each way, on the 13:00–15:00 departures: Kanada 13:05, 13:25, 13:50, 14:05 (the 14:35 slot has no trip); bus station 13:05, 13:25, 13:35, 14:05 (13:25 has none; 13:10 and 13:50 are off the pattern). Two buses; one bus every 40 (as until 25 Oct) leaves two window slots empty (owner check).

703.note: Bus station – Konská, PZ (the works): shift trips, three buses out at 13:18–13:30 and two back at 14:03 / 14:08, and the same at the other shift changes (5:14–5:30 out, 6:05 / 6:10 back; 21:23 / 21:26 out, 22:05–22:15 back). A shift line, so every 480 (as 709): bus station 13:18, 13:30 (5:18 / 5:30 and 21:18 / 21:30 within 2–5 min of the other shifts), PZ 14:03, 14:08 (6:03 / 6:08, 22:03 / 22:08 within 2 min). Two buses (owner check: one bus, the 13:30 / 14:03 round off). 13:21 from Kamionka passes the bus station 3 min off the 13:18 slot; the 12:10 / 12:25 and 17:30 / 18:12 rounds and the morning 7:49 / 7:59 are off the pattern (their stops are on the line).

704.note: Bus station – Konská, Podlesí about hourly (:45 out, :03 back most of the day) with holes; in the afternoon 13:35, 14:30, 14:45 out and 13:52, 15:00 back. Every 120 with two slots: bus station 13:35 and 14:45, Podlesí 13:52 and 15:00, one bus (it turns at Podlesí 14:57 → 15:00 as the real one does). 14:30 and the evening trips (16:45 on, 17:10, 17:45) are off the pattern or on it only at even hours. The diversion timetable (to 12 Dec) runs.

706.note: Bus station – Kojkovice and bus station – Osůvky – Borek are two branch lines until 15:00 (Kojkovice 13:40, 14:35, back 13:05, 13:55; Osůvky 13:35, 14:30, back 13:05, 14:01); from 15:35 (and at 8:35, 10:45) one trip an hour runs via Osůvky and Borek to Kojkovice, :35 out, :00 / :55 back. Those combined trips are off both rows (their stops are on 706 and 706 Osůvky). Each branch is one bus every 120 with two slots each way, exact in 13:00–15:00, the two 5 min apart at the bus station.

707.note: Circle via Horní and Dolní Líštná hourly at :35 (14:35–18:35; 13:40 and 12:45 before). The short circle to Horní Líštná, státní hranice only (12:10, 14:39), and the morning trips that skip Valovka, serve stops of the full circle and are off the pattern. One bus.

708.note: Bus station – Lyžbice, Kamionka every 30: in the morning 8:15–12:15 (:15 / :45, back :14 / :44) and in the afternoon 14:45–16:45 out (:15 / :45, the first three from the station) and 15:13–17:09 back (:09 / :39). The model hour is set to that run (15:10–17:10; the default 15:30–17:30 runs past its end). Every 30, bus station :15, Kamionka :09, two buses, as the real ones (1TD1410, 71-1157) work it.

709.note: Works trips to Konská, válcovna C at the shift change (13:30 / 14:09), every 480. Válcovna C has no other line.

712.note: Station – Tyra hourly at :40 most of the day; in the afternoon 13:33 and 14:22 instead of 13:40 / 14:40, then 15:40, 16:40. Back from Tyra about :05 at pila. Every 120 with two slots: station 14:22 and 15:40, Tyra 15:00 and 15:44 (at pila 15:02, 15:46), timed so the bus passes Tyra, pila on time; two buses. 16:40, 18:40 (even hours) and 16:05, 17:10 back are off the pattern. The Kozinec trips every 4 h (14:35 / 14:58) are 712 Kozinec.

768.note: Bus station – Vendryně, vápenka: shift trips (12:41 / 13:02), every 480. Vápenka and stadion have no other line.

714.note: Bus station – Oldřichovice, ves: a few trips (13:37, 14:30 out; 13:00, 14:03 back in the afternoon). Every 120 with two slots each way on those, one bus. 12:40 (from the station), 15:45 and 16:05 are off the pattern; 14:55 runs to restaurace only.

715.note: Circle from Sosna hospital at :10 and :50 (8:10–12:10 and 14:50–17:10, two buses); 13:25, 13:50 and 14:15 between are a midday shift rhythm, and 13:30 from the bus station is a short trip to Sosna. Model hour 16:00, where the circle’s own pattern runs (by its Sosna departures 13:20–15:20 has one more than 15:00–17:00). Every 60 with two slots, :10 and :50, two buses.

716.note: Bus station – Nebory – Guty at irregular times (14:20, 15:35, 16:20, 18:48 out; 15:00, 16:10, 16:55 back), two rounds in the afternoon peak (15:35 → 16:10, 16:20 → 16:55; each bus turns in 1 min at Guty). Every 120 with two slots each way: bus station 14:20 and 15:35, Guty 16:10 and 16:55; two buses, as two ran (owner check: one bus every 120, half the rate). 13:10, 18:48 and 15:00 back are off the pattern. The diversion timetable (to 12 Dec, 21 trips instead of 7) runs.

301.note: Riviéra – Lískovec, Marlenka four times an hour. Riviéra leaves at :03, :13, :33 and :43 until 15:43; Marlenka at :03, :13, :33, :43 until 14:03 and at :03, :23, :33, :43 from 14:23: its :23 is the bus that leaves Riviéra at :43, runs on past Marlenka to Řepiště, U kříže and comes back through Marlenka (the Řepiště stops are on 311). The Simutrans line is every 60 with four slots at each end, exact 14:13–16:03 both ways; 5 buses, one of them waits 55 min at Riviéra, where the real buses go on as 311 or 302 (pooling is the owner’s choice).
